Recorded claim:
Thunderbird has its own common.css, so an upstream macOS fix needed a comm port. The rule resets margin-inline-start only for menulist popups without a position attribute. The bug reproduced a 13-pixel left shift in Settings font menus. Keep the platform and selector scope when editing popup alignment.

Provenance: e4fff866e2c745d1b093e476820dcb67a854206b5738d11ad1c967a36b4a5d35. Original evidence IDs: 13df22ae899dafb4e6be14932170b865a7972b313067c778bd594065c25c534e, 89128cefbe97f1d6f6bc5181522739ec17077ac9f9349692316c9e00d2ad4e34, f82b144553d763e1ac2f740156dbe6544ddc5a305f2f26c7bb7c99e4930c3e04.
